body.name: Acquired regime \(\operatorname{Reg}(S)\)
body.construction: For \(S\in\Pi\), query \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}(S)\) once. If the reply is \((h_S,\operatorname{supp}_S)\), define \(\operatorname{Reg}(S)=h_S\) with the returned exact support over its recorded assignment labels and READ outputs; if the reply is \(\bot\), \(\operatorname{Reg}(S)\) is unavailable. Repeated slices of one protocol reuse the cached handle and support table.
